The band-4 records and the 48.6 vs 28 min duration [F9][F10][F2] are corroborative only; RD-4(b) states band evidence does not exempt a segment on its own in the MVP, and fair weather with 0.0 mm rain [F12] supplies no further cause [RD-4].

The absence of any rider instruction [F7] does not exempt the segment; with no driver proposal and no rider agreement the change fails RD-5, and the segment remains unexempted under RD-1/RD-2 [F3][RD-5].

The arithmetic is accepted but the conclusion is not: the single segment [F3] is unexempted, so the metered extra distance it caused is refundable under RD-2 at 2.11 km × $1.41/km = $2.98 [F3][F6][RD-2]; the ~0.25 km residue is non-refundable matching residual [F1][F4].

Rider profile facts [F13] are not relied upon: profile facts never decide a case alone; the refund rests on the GPS off-route segment [F3] and the fare records [F6][RD-2].
